'''Maw Command''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] splinter faction. During the later stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it pledged itself to the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]].
